state.scope: Assess a general typed-workflow design question. Only a generic scenario and publicly documented API properties follow; there are no private files, real email records, internal architecture details, authentication data or private application names. The topic is unrelated to optional provider dependency closure.
state.public_facts: According to the public TypeSafe references, a batch can mix independently answered binary, categorical and ordered-level judgments. The binary primitive supplies only the chance of yes. The categorical primitive supplies a chosen category, the entire distribution and confidence. The ordered primitive supplies a ranked descriptive legend, probabilities, confidence and the weighted numerical level, including intermediate values. Public Ollama decision documentation offers similar operations with a different range of allowed option counts. Distribution-derived confidence is not a correctness guarantee; provider acceptance is not domain validation. Documentation: https://docs.typesafe.ai/api https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/noul https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/choice https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/score https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/decision
state.design_case: A prospective concise business language has typed stored models, enum fields, grouped external-interface imports, queued effects with typed outcomes and generated screens. A representative email handler needs one reply-required probability, a four-way departmental suggestion and a three-step urgency rubric. Question wording, category IDs and ordered descriptions should each have one authored definition. Historical runs must keep submitted context/specification, complete results and version identity, with staff correction recorded separately. A queue's category should be able to reuse the same literal type as the judgment. All approaches require strict correlation and validation of responses against frozen requests. No installed-language compatibility must be preserved. New syntax has a compiler/editor cost; avoiding it through generic arrays imposes repeated answer selection and runtime narrowing on app authors.
state.privacy_case: Reading rights differ by department, and moving an email to another queue makes it readable there. Designated intake staff are authorized to approve such moves; a prediction is not itself that approval. The system has no domain-labeled calibration set and no signed-off confidence cutoff for automatic movement. The aim is to make intake easier without concealing uncertainty or presenting an arbitrary cutoff as validated policy. Either policy retains predictions, distributions and a traceable human override.

surface.instructions: For this concrete class of workflow, which representation offers the strongest overall balance of one-time authoring, categorical type reuse, trustworthy evidence and reasonable implementation effort?

criteria.derived: Add a small schema-generating question construct: it derives the evaluate signature, result schema, literal categories and immutable specification from the question body, requiring targeted parser and semantic support.
criteria.standard_arrays: Define standard typed lists for requests and replies using existing notation, with adapter-side exact validation; consuming code still identifies answer entries by text keys and validates or narrows text-valued categories.
criteria.custom_schema: Write a specialized ordinary service/output contract per application, obtaining precise enums with no syntax extension but duplicating categorical/rubric structure between the request description and response definition.

routing.instructions: Which default should the first release use for moving messages across these reader boundaries, considering both evidence quality and triage workload?

criteria.review_transfer: Use classification to propose and explain a destination, leaving the actual visibility-changing move to an authorized reviewer; this retains a manual step but supports it with model assistance.
criteria.threshold_transfer: Let a selected confidence cutoff trigger automatic reassignment to an allowed destination and reserve human review for ambiguous cases; this saves more routine work while accepting a cutoff unsupported by domain evaluation.
